title: Merchant Frequency and Loyalty Leaks
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as spend, count as visits by merchant
| where visits>=4
| sort - spend
description: Ranks the merchants you spend with most often, revealing where your money quietly concentrates.
value: Knowing your top merchants highlights where a loyalty scheme, subscription swap, or habit change would save the most.
implementation: Ingest transactions into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and rank merchants by spend and visits.
visualization: Bar chart of spend by most-frequent merchant.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which shops you spend the most at, revealing where your money quietly goes.
